1.def: Past Continuous — o'tgan zamonda ma'lum paytda davom etayotgan (jarayondagi) ish: «... qilib turgan edim». Fon va jarayonni tasvirlashda ishlatiladi.
forms: I was reading at nine. They were playing.
What were you doing at 8 pm?
rules: I / he / she / it → was; we / you / they → were.
Belgi: at 5 o'clock yesterday, at that moment, all evening, while.
Holat fe'llari (know, like) -ing olmaydi.
ex: At 7 pm yesterday I was cooking dinner.
Kecha soat 7 da kechki ovqat tayyorlayotgan edim.
It was raining when we left.
What were you doing when I called?
Men qo'ng'iroq qilganimda nima qilayotgan eding?

2.def: Past Simple qisqa, tugagan ish uchun; Past Continuous uzoq davom etgan fon uchun. Qisqa ish uzoq jarayonni to'xtatganda: uzoq — Continuous, qisqa — Simple. when — ko'pincha Simple bilan, while — Continuous bilan.
forms: was / were + fe'l-ing + when + Past Simple
I was walking when it started to rain.
While I was cooking, he was watching TV.
I opened the door and saw her.
rules: when + qisqa voqea (Simple); while + uzoq jarayon (Continuous).
Ketma-ket ishlar Simple bilan, fon Continuous bilan.
ex: The phone rang while I was having a shower.
When I arrived, they were eating.
She fell while she was running.
err: While I walked, I met Tom.
While I was walking, I met Tom.
I was opening the door and went in.
I opened the door and went in.

3.def: used to — o'tgan zamondagi tugagan odat yoki holat: «ilgari ... qilardim / edi». Hozirda endi bunday emas.
forms: I used to play football every day.
She didn't use to like coffee.
Did you use to live here?
rules: Hamma shaxslarda bir xil: I / he / they used to.
Inkor va savolda 'used' emas, 'use' bo'ladi (did bilan).
'Hozir' shakli yo'q: hozirgi odat uchun Present Simple.
ex: I used to walk to school, but now I take a bus.
Ilgari maktabga piyoda borardim, endi avtobusda boraman.
He didn't use to wear glasses.
Did you use to have a dog?
err: Did you used to live here?
Did you use to live here?

4.def: Present Perfect — o'tgan zamonda boshlangan, lekin hozirga aloqasi bor ish yoki hayotiy tajriba. Aniq vaqt aytilmaydi, natija muhim.
forms: I have finished. She has lost her keys.
rules: V3: to'g'ri fe'llarda -ed (worked); noto'g'rilarda 3-ustun (gone, seen, done, eaten, written).
he / she / it → has.
Aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, in 2010) bilan ishlatilmaydi.
ex: I have lost my phone. (hali topmadim)
We have lived here for ten years.
Biz bu yerda o'n yildan beri yashaymiz.

5.def: ever va never — hayotiy tajriba haqida: «hech qachon / biror marta». Have you ever...? — «Hech ... qilganmisiz?» Present Perfect bilan ishlatiladi.
forms: Have you ever been to London?
Yes, I have. / I have been there twice.
I have visited Paris three times.
rules: ever — savolda; never — darak gapda (inkor ma'noli, not yo'q).
been (to) — borib kelgan; gone (to) — ketgan va hali qaytmagan.
Tajriba haqida so'ragandan keyin aniq vaqt so'ralsa, Past Simple: When did you go?
ex: Have you ever ridden a horse? — No, never.
She has been to Turkey twice.
err: Did you ever go to Paris? (tajriba)
Have you ever been to Paris?

6.def: just, already, yet — Present Perfect bilan ishlatiladigan so'zlar: just — hozirgina, already — allaqachon, yet — hali (inkor va savolda).
forms: I haven't eaten yet. Have you called yet?
rules: just va already fe'l oldida (have va V3 orasida) turadi.
yet gapning oxirida keladi.
Amerika ingliz tilida Past Simple ham mumkin: Did you eat yet?
ex: I have just sent the email.
Have you done your homework yet? — Not yet.

7.def: for va since — Present Perfect bilan davomiylikni bildiradi. for — qancha vaqt davomida (muddat), since — qachondan beri (boshlanish nuqtasi). How long ...? — «qancha vaqtdan beri?»
forms: for two hours, for five years, for a long time
since 2020, since Monday, since I was a child
How long + have / has + subject + V3?
How long have you lived here?
rules: for = muddat, since = boshlanish nuqtasi.
Holat fe'llari bilan: I have known him for years (have been knowing emas).
Hozir ham davom etayotganini ko'rsatadi.
ex: Men bu yerda 2019 dan beri ishlayman.
She has been my friend for ten years.
U o'n yildan beri mening do'stim.
How long have you studied English?
Ingliz tilini qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganasan?
err: I have waited since two hours.
I have waited for two hours.

8.def: Present Perfect — o'tgan zamonda boshlangan, hozirga aloqasi bor ish (vaqt noma'lum yoki hali tugamagan). Past Simple — tugagan, aniq o'tgan vaqtdagi ish. Asosiy farq: «aniq vaqt bormi?»
rules: Past Simple belgilari: yesterday, last year, in 2015, ago, when ...?
Present Perfect belgilari: ever, never, just, already, yet, so far, this week, for, since.
this morning / today: davr tugamagan bo'lsa — Present Perfect.
ex: I lost my key yesterday. I have lost my key. (hozir ham yo'q)
U 2015 dan beri shu yerda yashaydi.
When did you arrive? — Two days ago.

9.def: will — gap gapirilayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qaror, va'da, taklif, bashorat va taxmin. Barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil, fe'l oddiy shaklda.
forms: I will call you. She will be late.
rules: Qisqartma: I'll, you'll, he'll, we'll, they'll.
Ishlatiladi: o'sha zahoti qaror (I'll have tea), va'da (I'll never lie), bashorat (It will rain), iltimos (Will you open the door?).
Belgi: tomorrow, soon, next year, I think, probably.
ex: I'm cold. I'll close the window.
I think it will rain tomorrow.
Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.

10.def: will — o'sha zahoti qabul qilingan qaror va taxmin; going to — oldindan qilingan reja yoki belgilarga asoslangan ishonchli bashorat.
forms: I'll take this one. (hozir qaror qildim)
am / is / are + going to + fe'l
I'm going to buy a car. (avvaldan rejam bor)
rules: Reja bo'lsa: going to. Hozir qaror qilinsa: will.
Ko'zga ko'ringan belgi: Look! He is going to fall.
Fikr / taxmin (I think, I'm sure, probably): will.
ex: I'm going to visit my parents on Sunday. (reja)
The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
err: — We need milk. — I'm going to buy it. (o'sha zahoti)
I will visit Paris next month (avvaldan bilsam)
I'm going to visit Paris next month.

11.def: Present Continuous kelasi zamon ma'nosida — aniq kelishilgan, tayyorlangan rejalar (vaqt va joy belgilangan): uchrashuv, chipta, ish rejasi.
forms: am / is / are + fe'l-ing + kelasi vaqt
What are you doing this weekend?
rules: Belgi: tomorrow, tonight, next week, on Friday, at 6 o'clock.
Aniq tartiblangan reja bo'lsa Continuous; umumiy niyat bo'lsa going to.
go / come bilan ko'p ishlatiladi: I'm going to the cinema tonight.
ex: I'm flying to Dubai on Monday. I've got the ticket.
Dushanba kuni Dubayga uchaman. Chiptam bor.
We are having a party on Saturday.

12.def: shall — faqat I va we bilan taklif qilish yoki fikr so'rash uchun: Shall I...? — «... qilaymi?», Shall we...? — «... qilamizmi?». Muloyim, yordam taklif qiluvchi savollar.
forms: Shall we go to the cinema?
rules: shall faqat I / we bilan savolda ishlatiladi.
Javob: Yes, please. / Good idea. / No, thanks.
Let's + fe'l ham shunday taklif: Let's go!
ex: Shall I carry your bag? — Yes, please.
It's hot. Shall we go to the park?

13.def: must — kuchli majburiyat (so'zlovchining o'z fikri); have to — tashqi qoida yoki zaruriyat (qonun, ish, jadval). Ikkalasi ham «kerak, majburman» deganidir.
forms: She has to wear a uniform.
Do / Does + subject + have to + fe'l?
Do you have to work on Sunday?
rules: must faqat hozirgi zamonda; o'tgan zamon — had to: I had to wait.
Savol va inkorda have to + do / does / did ishlatiladi.
Qoida (maktab, ish): have to; shaxsiy fikr: must.
ex: You must wear a seat belt.
I have to get up at 6 every day.
Men har kuni soat 6 da turishim kerak.
Yesterday we had to stay late.
Kecha biz kechgacha qolishimizga to'g'ri keldi.
err: Do you have to wear it?

14.def: mustn't — taqiq («mumkin emas»); don't have to — zarurat yo'q («shart emas», xohlasangiz qiling). Ikkalasi ma'nosi butunlay boshqacha.
rules: mustn't = qilish mumkin emas (taqiq / xavf).
don't have to = ixtiyoriy, majburiyat yo'q.
need not / needn't ham «shart emas» ma'nosida.
ex: You mustn't use your phone in the exam.
It's Sunday. I don't have to work.
Children mustn't play near the road.
err: You don't have to touch it. (xavfli!)

15.def: should — maslahat va tavsiya: «... qilgan yaxshi, ... qilish kerak». Majburiyat emas, balki yaxshi fikr.
forms: You shouldn't eat so much sugar.
rules: I think you should... — maslahat berishning odatiy usuli.
Barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil, -s yo'q, 'to' yo'q.
ought to ham shu ma'noda.
ex: You look tired. You should go to bed early.

16.def: might va may — kelajak yoki hozirgi vaqtdagi ehtimol: «balki, ehtimol». may — ruxsat so'rash uchun ham. Ehtimol past (taxminan 50%).
forms: It might rain. She may come late.
rules: Shaxsga qarab o'zgarmaydi, -s yo'q.
might / may ≈ perhaps: Perhaps it will rain = It might rain.
may ruxsat so'rashda juda muloyim.
ex: I might go to the party, but I'm not sure.
Ehtimol, bayramga boraman, lekin aniq emasman.

17.def: So do I / Neither do I — boshqa odamning fikriga qo'shilish: «Men ham», «Men ham yo'q». Javobdagi yordamchi fe'l birinchi gapdagi fe'lga mos bo'ladi.
forms: I like tea. — So do I.
I don't like tea. — Neither do I.
I like it. — Really? I don't.
rules: Fe'l mosligi: be → am / is / are; Simple → do / does; o'tgan → did; have + V3 → have; can → can; will → will.
Neither (yoki Nor) + ijobiy yordamchi fe'l (inkor ma'nosi bor).
ex: She didn't go. — Neither did he.
I can swim. — So can my brother.
err: I like it. — So I do.
I don't know. — Neither don't I.

18.def: Ichki (bilvosita) savol — muloyim savol: «Qayerda ekanini bilasizmi?» Ichki savolda so'z tartibi darak gapdagidek bo'ladi (yordamchi fe'l oldinga chiqmaydi).
forms: Do you know / Could you tell me + wh-so'z + ega + fe'l
Do you know where he lives?
Can you tell me if she is at home?
rules: Oddiy savol: Where does he live? → ichki: ... where he lives. (does yo'q)
Kirish iborasidagina savol tartibi saqlanadi: Do you know...?
Oxirida so'roq belgisi kirish iborasi uchun.
ex: Could you tell me where the station is?
Do you know what time the shop opens?
I don't know if he will come.
err: Do you know where does he live?
Do you know where he lives?
Can you tell me where is the bank?
Can you tell me where the bank is?

19.def: Sifat otni tasvirlaydi (a quick car); ravish fe'lni tasvirlaydi — qanday qilib? (He drives quickly). Ko'pchilik ravishlar sifatga -ly qo'shib yasaladi.
forms: She is a careful driver. The food is good.
quick → quickly, slow → slowly, careful → carefully
good → well; fast → fast; hard → hard; late → late
He speaks English well. She works hard.
rules: -y bilan tugasa → -ily: happy → happily.
be, look, feel, sound, taste dan keyin SIFAT keladi: You look tired. It tastes good.
hardly = deyarli ... emas (hard dan farqli).
ex: She plays the piano very well.

20.def: Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi: «... dan ko'ra ...roq». Qisqa sifatga -er, uzun sifat oldiga more qo'yiladi, keyin than keladi.
forms: tall → taller than, big → bigger than
more expensive than, more interesting than
good → better, bad → worse, far → farther
My phone is better than yours.
rules: -y bilan tugasa: happy → happier.
Qisqa unli + undosh: big → bigger, hot → hotter.
much / a lot / far + qiyosiy: much bigger (ancha kattaroq).
ex: This book is more interesting than that one.

21.def: Orttirma daraja — guruh ichida eng ... narsa: «eng katta, eng yaxshi». Oldidan the qo'yiladi: qisqa sifatga -est, uzun sifat oldiga most.
forms: the tallest, the biggest, the happiest
the most expensive, the most beautiful
good → the best; bad → the worst; far → the farthest
rules: Ko'pincha in / of bilan: the biggest city in the country, the best of all.
the doim kerak.
one of the + orttirma + ko'plik: one of the best films.
ex: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
This is the most delicious cake I've ever eaten.
Bu men yegan eng mazali tort.
He is the youngest in the team.
err: He is tallest in the class.
He is the tallest in the class.

22.def: as ... as — ikki narsaning tengligi («... kabi ...»); not as ... as — bir narsa ikkinchisidan kam. Qiyoslashning uchinchi usuli.
forms: I am as tall as my brother.
This phone isn't as expensive as that one.
My bag is the same as yours.
rules: Sifat o'zgarmaydi: as tall as (as taller as emas).
not as ... as = less ... than.
as much as / as many as — miqdor tengligi.
ex: She is as clever as her sister.
English isn't as difficult as I thought.
Ingliz tili men o'ylagandek qiyin emas.
Run as fast as you can!
err: He is as tall than me.
He is as tall as me.

23.def: too — «ortiqcha, haddan tashqari» (salbiy oqibat); enough — «yetarli». too oldida, enough sifatdan keyin keladi.
forms: It's too hot. He is too young to drive.
She is old enough to vote.
rules: too much (sanalmaydigan) / too many (sanaladigan) — haddan ko'p.
not enough = yetarli emas.
too ≠ very: very hot (shunchaki issiq), too hot (chidab bo'lmaydi).
ex: This bag is too heavy for me.
Bu sumka men uchun juda og'ir.
Is the water warm enough to swim?
There are too many people here.

24.def: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing shakli (gerund), ba'zilaridan keyin to + fe'l (infinitive) keladi. Qaysi fe'ldan keyin nima kelishini yodlash kerak.
forms: enjoy, like, love, hate, finish, stop, mind, keep + -ing
I enjoy reading. She finished cooking.
want, need, decide, hope, plan, learn, promise + to
I want to go. He decided to leave.
interested in learning, good at swimming
rules: like / love / hate ikkalasini ham oladi: I like swimming = I like to swim.
Maqsad: to + fe'l: I came here to study.
would like / want + to + fe'l.
ex: We decided to take a taxi.
